post.originalText:
I’ve been testing VectorCraft, the Adobe Illustrator clone, through its MCP server. So I prompted Claude Opus 5.5 to create a phone wallpaper in the style of “The Great Wave off Kanagawa”.

Some observations:

Claude rendered the canvas after every stage and fixed what it saw.
Batches can be atomic, so one undo rolls back the whole batch.
VectorCraft takes raw SVG path data. 
Gradients, blend modes and live effects all come through the MCP.
